Working with us means believing in the future; in the great people who are shaping it together every day and in the wide-ranging career paths it opens up. #believeinyourselfErste Group was founded in 1819 as the first Austrian savings bank and today it is one of the largest banking groups in Central and Eastern Europe (CEE). As an attractive employer, Erste Group offers interesting career opportunities in an international environment. 1 Internships Balance Sheet Management (all genders)  * Location:Wien
 * Working hours:Part-time

 * Occupational Area:Finance / Controlling / Accounting

 * Company:Erste Group Bank AG

Group Balance Sheet Management is responsible for the overall Liquidity Management, Interest Rate positioning, Banking Book bond investments and the Capital position of the overall Erste Group with a total balance sheet of around €460bn. The specific areas of focus are:

 * Liquidity management, including liquidity ratio compliance, active monitoring and management of liquidity, Fund Transfer Pricing and steering of wholesale market issuance

 * Banking book investments, with a portfolio of over €90bn across the group

 * Interest rate analytic, steering and active management including behavioural model analysis and interest rate hedging activities

 * Capital management (including optimization activities) and Resolution and Recovery strategy

 * Covered bond and securitization analytics and reporting and hedge accounting

Your Tasks

 * Supporting the team in regulatory, management and transaction-related reports

 * Working with and analysing financial data

 * Collaborating with different entities and/or functions across Erste Group

 * Maintaining and further developing analytical tools, reports and data solutions

 * Supporting ongoing projects and process improvements, including opportunities for automation and digitalisation

Your Background

 * Ongoing studies at FH/University, preferably in banking, finance, business law, economics, business informatics, mathematics, statistics, data science or a comparable field

 * Basic knowledge and/or interest in Asset & Liability Management, banking & financial markets and securitization are an advantage

 * Solid analytical skills with the ambition and capability to establish new know how and learn constantly

 * You are fluent in German and/or English

 * IT-skills: excellent MS-Office skills as must, basic knowledge in SQL appreciated

 * As this job advertisement is valid for more than one position, depending on the concrete position a more or less technical background and skillset can be relevant (e.g. SAS enterprise guide or C#.net or Databricks)

Our Offer

 * Possibility to establish know how in one or several of the above mentioned areas

 * Exciting and challenging internship for 12 months part-time (19.25h/week) with a start either in December 2026 or January 2027, depending on the concrete position

 * Support of your professional and personal development in a dynamic, comprehensive and interesting area

 * We guarantee an internship allowance of minimum EUR 2,745.32 gross per month on a full-time basis (except obligatory internships)

 * Discover and enjoy the https://www.erstegroup.com/en/career/benefits of Erste Group

 * We offer our employees the opportunity to divide their hours between working from home and at the office

 * We consider the diversity of our employees as key to innovation and success. As employer we are proud to offer everyone equal chances, irrespective of age, skin colour, religious belief, gender, sexual orientation or origin

As a Forward Deployed Engineer for our Spanish market, you work directly at the intersection of product and customer setups. You capture requirements, translate them into robust implementations, and take fonio live at customers - including integrations, automations, and ongoing optimization.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Head of Partnerships (m/f/d) The role

Partnerships is a major growth channel for fonio as we expand into new markets. As Head of Partnerships, you'll own the strategy and the results across two tracks:

 * Channel partners: resellers, referral partners, small agencies and IT shops. They activate fast, come in high volume and scale well.

 * Strategic partners: larger platforms, telcos and ecosystems. Cycles are longer and the prize is bigger.

You'll set the direction for both and decide where we place our bets. You'll also lead the team that delivers it.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the room with partners, running calls and closing deals alongside your team. For us, partner activation is a sales motion. Success means partners who bring in revenue.

What you'll do

 * Own the partnerships strategy and revenue targets across channel and strategic partners.

 * Design and scale the partner program: partner types, incentives, onboarding and enablement.

 * Build a repeatable playbook from first conversation to first joint deal closed.

 * Adapt the model by market. Partnerships work very differently in DACH, Southern Europe, the UK and the US.

 * Lead and grow the partnerships team. Set clear priorities, coach, and hire as the channel scales.

 * Own the numbers: partner-sourced revenue, partners activated, time to first deal, and repeat activation.

 * Work with Sales, Marketing and Product on co-selling, co-marketing and integrations.

What you bring

 * You've led a partnerships or channel team at a SaaS company. AI is a bonus.

 * You come from a sales background and have carried a number. You treat partner activation as selling.

 * You've worked with partners in more than one market, ideally including the US and a European region.

 * You've built or scaled a partner program and know how to adapt it to different types of partner.

 * You have a track record of growing quickly into bigger scope and bigger teams.

 * You're fluent in English. German or Spanish is a plus.

 * You're comfortable travelling regularly to Vienna and to partner events.

What you get

 * Real ownership of a function that sits at the centre of our international growth.

 * A direct line to the CCO.

 * A team of ambitious people, many of them former founders.

 * Salary: €120000 - €160000 OTE, plus significant equity.

 * Everything you need to be successful - if you need it - you?ll get it.

Process

 * Skill Interview with CCO (60 mins)

 * Interview with CEO (30 mins)

 * Culture Call (20 mins)

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Financial Accountant (m/f/d) The role

You make sure Fonio's numbers are right and can stand up to auditors and investors. That means owning the monthly and year-end close, and solving tricky questions such as how to account for pay-per-minute revenue across nine markets and more.

As new entities and products launch, you set up the accounting so it scales, rather than patching it later.

What to Expect

 * In-house accounting: Take over accounting from our external provider and build the internal function.

 * Operational ownership: Own day-to-day accounting, including AP/AR, reconciliations, master data and bookkeeping.

 * Monthly close & reporting: Own monthly closing and recurring statutory filings (VAT, ZM, Intrastat, etc.), working closely with our tax advisors.

 * Revenue recognition: make sure usage-based revenue is recognised correctly and consistently.

 * Multi-entity: run intercompany accounting, currencies and consolidation as UK and US entities come online, and integrate acquisitions such as fluently.

 * Controls and policies: write accounting policies and controls that hold up in investor due diligence.

 * Oversight: keep billing, payables and payroll postings accurate, and improve processes and systems as volume grows.

What You Bring

Must-haves

 * 4 to 7 years in accounting, ideally with audit firm training plus time at a tech or SaaS company.

 * Qualified or part-qualified (Bilanzbuchhalter, ACCA, CPA or similar).

 * Has owned month-end and year-end close and statutory accounts under Austrian GAAP (UGB).

 * Confident handling audits and technical accounting questions.

 * Fluent in English.

Nice-to-haves

 * Revenue recognition for subscription or usage-based pricing.

 * Multi-entity consolidation, or IFRS exposure.

 * Experience with post-merger integration or investor due diligence.

 * Familiar with modern finance tools (e.g. BMD, DATEV, Xero or Stripe).

What We Offer

 * €65,000 to €100,000 + Equity

 * Relocation support

 * Daily lunch and dinner

 * Equipment of your choice

 * Regular team off-sites

 * On-site in Vienna, working directly with the core-team
